Thousands protest overs prices, education, military spending in France and Europe

France is bracing for a sixth consecutive Saturday of protests, with demonstrators expected to rally over the rising cost of living and the government's handling of weeks of social unrest ahead of next year's presidential election. France 24 journalist Antonia Kerrigan tells us the latest from Paris.
